name: right-suite
description: Test your price, landing page, cold email, ads and positioning on 100+ AI-simulated buyers before you launch. Ask whether buyers would pay $29, whether your landing page lands, or who to sell to first. In 10 to 20 minutes you get a verdict, the top objections and what to change.

interface.shortDescription: Test your price on AI buyers
interface.longDescription:
Right Suite shows your price, landing page, cold email, ad or positioning to 100+ AI-simulated buyers modelled on the audience you describe, before you spend a dollar on launch.

Ask things like "would SaaS founders pay $29 a month for this?", "roast my landing page hero", "will this cold email get replies?" or "who should I sell to first?". Right Suite starts a run, shows progress as buyers react, and comes back with a verdict, the objections that came up most, real quotes and the changes to make.

Seven tools: price testing, landing page and copy testing, cold email and DM testing, ad testing, audience finding, positioning against competitors, and channel picking. Runs use your Right Suite credits; new accounts get free credits to start.
capabilities: Test a price on simulated buyers
Test a landing page or marketing copy
Test a cold email or DM
Find the best audience to sell to first
Follow a run live and read the report
defaultPrompt: Would solo founders pay $29 a month for my product?
Roast my landing page hero before I launch
Will this cold email get replies from agency owners?

positive.prompt: Use Right Suite to test whether freelance designers would pay $19/month for an invoicing app that chases late payments automatically. Depth 1.
positive.expected_behavior: Confirms what will be tested and the 1-credit cost, starts a run, returns a runId and dashboard link, follows progress with get_report and summarises the verdict, top objections and suggested price.

positive.prompt: Test this landing page hero on early-stage SaaS founders: 'Know what to charge before you launch. Test your price on 100 AI buyers in 15 minutes.'
positive.expected_behavior: Starts a landing page run for the stated audience, reports progress, then gives the verdict, what confused or convinced buyers, and copy changes.

positive.prompt: Will this cold email get replies from marketing agency owners? Subject: Quick question about your client reporting. Body: Hi, we built a tool that turns client reports into a 2-minute video. Worth a look?
positive.expected_behavior: Starts a cold email run, follows it, and reports the predicted reply intent, killer lines and a rewrite suggestion.

positive.prompt: How many Right Suite credits do I have left?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the user's current credit balance in plain words.

positive.prompt: Show me my recent Right Suite runs.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists recent runs with their product, status and date, and offers to open a report.

negative.prompt: Write me a cold email for selling bookkeeping services to dentists.
What's the weather in London tomorrow?
Explain the difference between value-based and cost-plus pricing.

publication.release_notes: First release: seven go-to-market tests on AI-simulated buyers, with live run progress in chat.
